name: netkstkovf
description: A socket call that runs off its process's kernel slot halts through _fcc_stkoflow with the report naming that slot's floor, instead of writing into the slot below it: bn_sysent sets fcc's stack floor from the slot it is entered on.  Only means anything at kernel.netprobe = 5, where BNOP_SOCKET recurses.  The release /etc/rc less the network modules (fixtures/rc.netlate) is staged, so the command's modload loads them and loopprobe -n makes the first socket call.
command: modload bsdnetd bsdnet0 bsdnet1 bsdnet2 bsdnet3; /testbin/loopprobe -n; echo NOT''REACHED

requires.reason: the overflowing socket call is compiled in only at kernel.netprobe = 5
